rule_descriptions.reused_droplet: Residual droplet from previous test was actively ignited, combined, or re-used.
rule_descriptions.attempted_reused_then_fresh: Re-use was attempted initially, then droplet was vaporized/lost and replaced.
rule_descriptions.ipsu_or_radiometer_failure: IPSU intensified camera failed continuous mode or radiometer detection failed.
rule_descriptions.fov_exit_confirmed: Comment states the droplet left or likely left the HiBMS/camera FOV before completion.
rule_descriptions.igniter_contact: Comment reports droplet physically hitting or contacting an igniter.
rule_descriptions.fiber_glow_or_slip: Noticeable fiber glow or physical slackening/sliding of droplet on support fiber.
rule_descriptions.obscuration_note: Dense vapor cloud, large soot agglomerate, or frozen downlink noted as impairing visibility.
